# RobotWorld

> Local-first desktop system for physical AI world-building: compiles provenance-tagged 3D objects
> into physically valid interactive assets, validates them in real MuJoCo contact physics with a
> pinned Franka Panda embodiment and deterministic IK oracles, and evaluates VLA vision-language-action
> policies with structured failure diagnosis.

RobotWorld is an Electron desktop application, not a public website. All functionality runs locally:
the React UI is served by the Electron shell (or a local dev server) and talks to a FastAPI control
plane on 127.0.0.1:8000.

## Main sections (hash-routed)

- /#/ : Overview — pipeline status and system summary
- /#/models : Model registry (local model roots, capability probing)
- /#/robots : Registered robots (Franka Panda MuJoCo)
- /#/assets : Rigid asset compiler (GLB QA → OpenUSD + MJCF)
- /#/worlds : World editor and authoritative simulation streaming
- /#/skills : Skill library and task definitions
- /#/evidence : Evidence collection pipeline
- /#/scraper-repair : Governed scraper self-heal state machine
- /#/failure-analysis : Failure taxonomy and coverage tracking
- /#/agent-control : Autonomous curriculum engine with budgets
- /#/training : Bounded fine-tune preflight and candidate lifecycle
- /#/observability : Self-hosted SigNoz traces/logs/metrics
- /#/settings : Local settings and integrations
